faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Removing Backgrounds
faq.intro: Learn how the AI background remover works, what files it accepts, how shared free uses work, and what happens to uploaded images.

items.question: How do I remove the background from an image?
items.answer: Upload or paste an image, sign in when you are ready to process it, and select Remove background. When processing finishes, preview the transparent result, choose an optional background color, and download the PNG.

items.question: Is the background remover free?
items.answer: You can try it with your WatermarkGemini free balance. Background removal and watermark removal share the same balance: a new eligible account receives one initial use, and daily check-in rewards can add uses up to the current account cap.

items.question: Which image formats are supported?
items.answer: You can upload JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, and JFIF images up to 10 MB. Results are delivered as PNG files so transparent pixels can be preserved.

items.question: Can I replace the removed background with a color?
items.answer: Yes. Keep the checkerboard option for transparency, select a preset color, or use the custom color picker. The chosen color is applied when the PNG is prepared for download.

items.question: Does it work with hair, fur, and detailed edges?
items.answer: The AI is designed to preserve fine subject edges, including hair and fur. A sharp, well-lit source image with visible separation between subject and background usually produces the cleanest result.

items.question: What happens to my uploaded image?
items.answer: Uploads and results are stored in private object storage and are designed to expire after 24 hours. For this feature, a short-lived signed input link is sent to Replicate for processing; Replicate's API prediction data is automatically removed after one hour under its current retention policy.

items.question: Can I remove the background from any image?
items.answer: Only upload images you own or are authorized to edit. Do not use the service to infringe copyright, privacy, trademark, or other rights, and avoid uploading confidential material.
